blocks.text: Ot + predlog: predlogni ot ham talab qiladi

Qizil kitobda sifat va fe'l o'zidan keyin ma'lum predlog talab qilishini ko'rdik: afraid **of**, listen **to** (→ qizil kitob, 112–113-darslar). Ot ham xuddi shunday: a reason **for**, the cause **of**, an increase **in**, a solution **to**, a relationship **with**. O'zbekchada bunday bog'lanish ko'pincha qaratqich kelishigi (`-ning`) va egalik qo'shimchasi bilan ifodalanadi: «muammo**ning** yechimi», «narxlar**ning** oshishi», «avariya**ning** sababi». Shuning uchun o'zbeklar deyarli har doim **of** ishlatib yuboradi: «the solution of the problem», «an increase of prices». Aslida har bir otning o'z predlogi bor va uni ot bilan birga yodlash kerak.
Fe'l predlogsiz, ot esa predlog bilan

Ko'p hollarda fe'l to'ldiruvchini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oladi, shu o'zakdan yasalgan ot esa predlog talab qiladi. Bu juftliklarni bilish ikki xatodan saqlaydi: fe'lga ortiqcha predlog qo'shish («discuss about») va otdan keyin predlogni tushirib qoldirish («an answer my question»).

items.text: There has been a sharp **increase in** the number of cyclists in Tashkent.
We had a long **discussion about** the budget, but nobody **discussed** salaries.
items.translation: Byudjet **haqida** uzoq **muhokama** qildik, lekin hech kim maoshlarni **muhokama qilmadi**.

items.text: Scientists still haven't found an **answer to** this question.
items.translation: Olimlar hali bu savol**ga javob** topishmagan.

blocks.text: for: a reason for, a need for, a demand for

**for** — ehtiyoj, talab, so'rov yoki asos: a **need for**, a **demand for**, a **request for**, a **reason for**, **respect for**, a cheque **for** £100. O'zbekchada odatda `-ga` (ehtiyoj, talab) yoki «-ning sababi»: «kechikish**ning** sababi» → the reason **for** the delay. Diqqat: **reason** dan keyin to'liq gap kelsa, predlog tushib qoladi: the reason **why** she left / the reason (that) she left. «the reason for why» — xato.
cause of yoki reason for? — ikki xil «sabab»

O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham «sabab», inglizchada esa farq bor. **the cause of** — hodisani **keltirib chiqargan** narsa (ko'pincha avariya, yong'in, kasallik): the cause **of** the fire. **the reason for** — kishining **qarori yoki xatti-harakati** izohi, asosi: the reason **for** her decision. Cause — «nima sabab bo'ldi?», reason — «nega shunday qildi?». Ba'zan ikkalasi ham mumkin (the cause of / the reason for the delay), lekin predloglar almashmaydi: «the cause for», «the reason of» — xato.

headers: the cause of — nima keltirib chiqardi
the reason for — nega shunday qilindi
rows: The **cause of** the fire was a faulty cable.
His **reason for** leaving was a better offer.
Smoking is a major **cause of** heart disease.
Is there any **reason for** this delay?
Police are investigating the **cause of** the crash.
She gave no **reason for** her decision.

blocks.text: of: an advantage of, a photo of, a lack of

**of** — narsaning xususiyati, tasviri yoki yetishmasligi: an **advantage / a disadvantage of** (afzalligi / kamchiligi), a **photo / picture / map / plan / drawing of** (... ning surati, xaritasi, rejasi), an **example of**, a **lack of** (... ning yetishmasligi), the **cost of** living. **There is / are** bilan advantage dan keyin **in** yoki **to** + -ing ham ishlatiladi: There are many advantages **to** living near the metro. Diqqat: a photo **of** my father — otam tasvirlangan; a photo **in** the newspaper — gazetada chiqqan surat.
in: an increase in, a fall in, a change in

**in** — miqdor yoki darajaning o'zgarishi: an **increase / a rise / a decrease / a fall / a drop / a change in** something. Nima o'zgargani **in** dan keyin keladi, o'zgarish miqdori esa **of** dan keyin: an increase **in** prices (narxlar oshdi), an increase **of** 10% (10 foizga). Ikkalasi bitta iborada: a rise **of** 5% **in** the price of bread. Shu guruhga **interest in** (... ga qiziqish) va **a degree in** (... bo'yicha diplom) ham kiradi.

items.text: Last year there was **a fall of** 15% **in** the number of road accidents.
**Interest in** learning Uzbek has grown among foreign students.
items.translation: Chet ellik talabalarning o'zbek tilini o'rganish**ga qiziqishi** ortdi.

items.text: The company announced **a rise of** 8% **in** salaries for all staff.
items.translation: Kompaniya barcha xodimlarning **maoshi** 8 **foizga oshirilishini** e'lon qildi.

blocks.text: to: a solution to, an answer to, damage to

**to** — biror narsaga **qaratilgan** javob yoki ta'sir: a **solution to** a problem, an **answer / a reply to** a question, a **reaction to** the news, the **key to** success (yoki the key **to** the door), an **invitation to** a party, **damage to** a car, an **attitude to / towards** work, an **approach to** teaching. O'zbekchada «muammo**ning** yechimi», «eshik**ning** kaliti» — qaratqich kelishigi, shuning uchun «solution of», «key of the door» — juda keng tarqalgan xato. **damage** — sanalmaydigan ot: «a damage», «damages to the car» emas, **damage to** the car.
with va between: munosabat va farq

a **relationship / connection / contact with** somebody — kim yoki nima bilandir munosabat, aloqa. Ikki tomon birga tilga olinsa — **between**: the relationship **between** the two countries, the difference **between** A **and** B, the connection **between** stress and illness. «A bilan B o'rtasidagi farq» → the difference **between** A and B («difference of A and B» emas). Yana: a **problem with** — ... bilan bog'liq muammo: There's a problem **with** my visa.

items.text: Our company has a good **relationship with** its suppliers in Fergana.
Is there a **connection between** sleep and memory?
I'm not sure I understand the **difference between** these two contracts.
items.translation: Bu ikki shartnoma **o'rtasidagi farqni** tushunganimga ishonchim komil emas.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «the solution of the problem» → the **solution to** the problem; «an increase of prices» → an **increase in** prices; «the reason of the delay» → the **reason for** the delay; «the cause for the fire» → the **cause of** the fire; «a damage of the car» → **damage to** the car; «the key of the door» → the **key to** the door; «the difference of two cities» → the **difference between** two cities; «my relationship to my boss» → my **relationship with** my boss; «the reason for why he left» → the **reason why** he left.

Predlogni yo'nalish orqali eslang. **to** — javob, yechim, kalit, zarar biror narsa **tomon** yo'naladi. **in** — o'zgarish biror narsaning **ichida** bo'ladi (narxlar ichida). **for** — ehtiyoj va talab biror narsa **uchun**. **of** — narsaning **o'zidan** chiqadigan: sababi, afzalligi, surati. Har bir yangi otni predlogi bilan kichik ibora qilib yozing: «a solution **to**», «an increase **in**».
Bog'lanish: sifat + predlog (angry with, proud of) — 130–131-darslar; fe'l + predlog — 132–136-darslar; predlogdan keyin -ing (a reason for leaving, the advantage of living) — 60-dars.
Xulosa

the cause of, an advantage / disadvantage of, a photo / map / plan of, a lack of

examples.title: Need, demand and reason: noun + **for**
examples.description: **for** — ehtiyoj, talab, so'rov va asos: a need for, a demand for, a request for, a reason for, respect for. reason dan keyin to'liq gap kelsa — the reason **why** / that.

sentences.text: At the moment there's a huge **demand for** electric scooters in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Hozir Toshkentda elektr samokatlar**ga talab** juda katta.

sentences.text: Is there really a **need for** another shopping centre in our area?
sentences.translation: Tumanimizda yana bitta savdo markazi**ga** haqiqatan **ehtiyoj** bormi?

sentences.text: The manager refused my **request for** an extra day off.
sentences.translation: Menejer qo'shimcha bir kun dam olish haqidagi **so'rovimni** rad etdi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza didn't give any **reason for** her sudden resignation.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza to'satdan ishdan ketishi**ning sababini** aytmadi.

sentences.text: What was the **reason for** the delay? — A technical problem with the engine.
sentences.translation: Kechikish**ning sababi** nima edi? — Dvigateldagi texnik nosozlik.

sentences.text: My grandfather often complains that young people have no **respect for** traditions.
sentences.translation: Bobom tez-tez yoshlarda urf-odatlar**ga hurmat** yo'q, deb noliydi.

sentences.text: Oliver received a **cheque for** £500 from the insurance company.
sentences.translation: Oliver sug'urta kompaniyasidan 500 funt sterlinglik **chek** oldi.

sentences.text: The **reason why** Jasur moved to Samarkand is that his wife found a job there.
sentences.translation: Jasurning Samarqandga ko'chib ketganining **sababi** — xotini u yerdan ish topgani.

sentences.text: After the article appeared, the **demand for** tickets was so high that the website crashed.
sentences.translation: Maqola chiqqach, chiptalar**ga talab** shunchalik oshdiki, sayt ishdan chiqdi.

sentences.text: There's no **need for** you to apologise — it wasn't your fault.
sentences.translation: Kechirim so'rashingiz**ga hojat** yo'q — siz aybdor emassiz.

examples.title: **cause of** or **reason for**?
examples.description: Ikkalasi ham «sabab»: the cause of — hodisani keltirib chiqargan narsa (yong'in, kasallik, avariya), the reason for — kishining qarori yoki harakatining izohi.

sentences.text: Engineers are still trying to find the **cause of** yesterday's power cut.
sentences.translation: Muhandislar hali ham kechagi elektr uzilishi**ning sababini** aniqlashga harakat qilyapti.

sentences.text: Stress is one of the main **causes of** headaches in office workers.
sentences.translation: Stress ofis xodimlaridagi bosh og'rig'i**ning** asosiy **sabablaridan** biri.

sentences.text: What's your **reason for** learning English — work or travel?
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini nima **sababdan** o'rganyapsiz — ish uchunmi yoki sayohat uchunmi?

sentences.text: Police haven't announced the **cause of** the crash on the Samarkand road yet.
sentences.translation: Politsiya Samarqand yo'lidagi avariya**ning sababini** hali e'lon qilmadi.

sentences.text: Kate explained her **reason for** turning down the job in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Keyt Edinburgdagi ishdan nima **sababdan** voz kechganini tushuntirdi.

sentences.text: A faulty heater was the **cause of** the fire, not a cigarette.
sentences.translation: Yong'in**ga** sigaret emas, nosoz isitgich **sabab bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: Is there any particular **reason for** choosing this hotel?
sentences.translation: Aynan shu mehmonxonani tanlaganingiz**ga** biror alohida **sabab** bormi?

sentences.text: Doctors believe that poor diet is the main **cause of** his illness.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar uning kasalligi**ga** asosan noto'g'ri ovqatlanish **sabab bo'lgan**, deb hisoblashadi.

sentences.text: The airline gave no **reason for** cancelling the flight, which made passengers furious.
sentences.translation: Aviakompaniya reysni bekor qilish **sababini** aytmadi, bu esa yo'lovchilarni qattiq g'azablantirdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod knew the **cause of** the leak, but he had no good **reason for** not fixing it.
sentences.translation: Bekzod suv oqishi**ning sababini** bilardi, lekin uni tuzatmaganiga hech qanday jo'yali **asos** yo'q edi.

examples.title: **advantage of**, **photo of**, **lack of**
examples.description: **of** — narsaning xususiyati, tasviri yoki yetishmasligi: an advantage / a disadvantage of, a photo / map / plan of, an example of, a lack of, the cost of. There is / are + advantage + **in** / **to** + -ing.

sentences.text: One big **advantage of** living in the centre is that you can walk everywhere.
sentences.translation: Markazda yashash**ning** katta **afzalligi** — hamma joyga piyoda borish mumkin.

sentences.text: The main **disadvantage of** this job is the long journey to work.
sentences.translation: Bu ish**ning** asosiy **kamchiligi** — ishga uzoq yo'l yurish.

sentences.text: Madina showed us a **photo of** her grandparents' house in Khiva.
sentences.translation: Madina bizga Xivadagi bobo-buvisining uyi**ning suratini** ko'rsatdi.

sentences.text: Have you got a **map of** the old city, or shall we use the phone?
sentences.translation: Eski shahar**ning xaritasi** bormi yoki telefondan foydalanamizmi?

sentences.text: The architect sent us a **plan of** the new kitchen before starting work.
sentences.translation: Me'mor ishni boshlashdan oldin bizga yangi oshxona**ning rejasini** yubordi.

sentences.text: Because of a **lack of** money, the project was stopped after six months.
sentences.translation: Mablag' **yetishmasligi** tufayli loyiha olti oydan so'ng to'xtatildi.

sentences.text: The **cost of** living in London is much higher than in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Londonda **turmush narxi** Manchesterdagidan ancha yuqori.

sentences.text: There are several **advantages to** working from home, but loneliness isn't one of them.
sentences.translation: Uydan ishlash**ning** bir qancha **afzalliklari** bor, lekin yolg'izlik ular qatoriga kirmaydi.

sentences.text: For historians, the Ark fortress in Bukhara is a fascinating **example of** medieval architecture.
sentences.translation: Tarixchilar uchun Buxorodagi Ark qal'asi o'rta asr me'morchiligi**ning** ajoyib **namunasi**.

sentences.text: Is there any **advantage in** booking early, or are the prices the same?
sentences.translation: Oldindan bron qilish**ning** biror **foydasi** bormi yoki narxlar bir xilmi?

examples.title: Changes: **increase in**, **fall in**, **rise of** 20%
examples.description: **in** — nima o'zgargani: an increase / a rise / a fall / a drop / a decrease / a change in. O'zgarish miqdori esa **of** bilan: an increase of 12%. Yana: interest in.

sentences.text: There has been a big **increase in** the price of petrol this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil benzin **narxi** ancha **oshdi**.

sentences.text: The government is worried about the **fall in** the birth rate.
sentences.translation: Hukumat tug'ilish darajasi**ning pasayishidan** xavotirda.

sentences.text: Our rent went up again, which means a **rise of** nearly 20% since last spring.
sentences.translation: Ijara haqimiz yana oshdi, ya'ni o'tgan bahordan beri deyarli 20 **foizga ko'tarildi**.

sentences.text: Doctors have noticed a sharp **drop in** the number of flu cases.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar gripp holatlari soni keskin **kamayganini** payqashdi.

sentences.text: Is there any **change in** the timetable for next week?
sentences.translation: Kelasi haftaning jadvali**da** biror **o'zgarish** bormi?

sentences.text: Since the new bypass opened, there's been a noticeable **decrease in** traffic in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Yangi aylanma yo'l ochilgandan beri shahar markazida tirbandlik sezilarli **darajada kamaydi**.

sentences.text: The company reported **an increase of** 12% **in** online sales.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya onlayn **savdo** 12 **foizga oshganini** ma'lum qildi.

sentences.text: Since the TV series came out, **interest in** Samarkand among British tourists has doubled.
sentences.translation: Serial chiqqandan beri britaniyalik sayyohlarning Samarqand**ga qiziqishi** ikki baravar oshdi.

sentences.text: A small **change in** your diet can make a big difference to your health.
sentences.translation: Ovqatlanishingiz**dagi** kichik **o'zgarish** sog'lig'ingizga katta ta'sir qilishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Why has there been such a **fall in** profits? — Mainly because fewer people are travelling.
sentences.translation: Nega foyda bunchalik **kamayib ketdi**? — Asosan sayohat qiluvchilar kamaygani uchun.

examples.title: Answers and solutions: **solution to**, **reply to**
examples.description: **to** — biror narsaga qaratilgan javob: a solution / an answer / a reply / a reaction / a response to, the key to. O'zbekchadagi «muammoning yechimi» ga qaramay — «solution of» emas.

sentences.text: Nobody has found a **solution to** the parking problem in our street.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi mashina qo'yish muammosi**ga** hali hech kim **yechim** topmadi.

sentences.text: I've been waiting for a **reply to** my email for over a week.
sentences.translation: Bir haftadan beri xatim**ga javob** kutyapman.

sentences.text: What was your boss's **reaction to** the news? — He was surprisingly calm.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'ingizning bu yangilik**ka munosabati** qanday bo'ldi? — Hayratlanarli darajada xotirjam edi.

sentences.text: Do you know the **answer to** question five? I'm completely stuck.
sentences.translation: Beshinchi savol**ga javobni** bilasizmi? Butunlay tiqilib qoldim.

sentences.text: Hard work is the **key to** success, but a bit of luck helps too.
sentences.translation: Mashaqqatli mehnat — muvaffaqiyat**ning kaliti**, lekin ozgina omad ham yordam beradi.

sentences.text: Where's the **key to** the back door? I want to put the bins out.
sentences.translation: Orqa eshik**ning kaliti** qayerda? Axlat qutilarini tashqariga chiqarmoqchiman.

sentences.text: The minister's **response to** the protests was a promise of new jobs.
sentences.translation: Vazirning noroziliklar**ga javobi** yangi ish o'rinlari va'dasi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Emma had a bad **reaction to** the antibiotics and had to stay in hospital.
sentences.translation: Emmaning organizmi antibiotiklar**ga** yomon **reaksiya** berdi va u kasalxonada qolishga majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: If we can't find a **solution to** this by Friday, the client will cancel the contract.
sentences.translation: Agar juma kunigacha bu**ga yechim** topa olmasak, mijoz shartnomani bekor qiladi.

sentences.text: There's no easy **answer to** the question of climate change.
sentences.translation: Iqlim o'zgarishi masalasi**ga** oson **javob** yo'q.

examples.title: **damage to**, **invitation to**, **attitude to**
examples.description: **to** bilan yana: damage to (... ga zarar; damage — sanalmaydi), an invitation to, an attitude to / towards, an approach to, a threat to.

sentences.text: The storm caused serious **damage to** the roof of our school.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron maktabimiz tomi**ga** jiddiy **zarar yetkazdi**.

sentences.text: Have you received an **invitation to** Jasur's wedding yet?
sentences.translation: Jasurning to'yi**ga taklifnoma** oldingizmi?

sentences.text: Kate's **attitude to** her studies has changed completely since she moved to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Oksfordga ko'chganidan beri Keytning o'qishi**ga munosabati** butunlay o'zgardi.

sentences.text: Luckily, there wasn't much **damage to** the car, but the driver hurt his arm.
sentences.translation: Baxtimizga, mashina**ga** unchalik **zarar yetmadi**, lekin haydovchi qo'lini lat yedi.

sentences.text: Our new teacher has a very modern **approach to** grammar.
sentences.translation: Yangi o'qituvchimizning grammatika**ga yondashuvi** juda zamonaviy.

sentences.text: Plastic waste is a serious **threat to** sea birds and fish.
sentences.translation: Plastik chiqindilar dengiz qushlari va baliqlar **uchun** jiddiy **xavf**.

sentences.text: I'm afraid I can't accept your kind **invitation to** dinner on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, shanba kungi kechki ovqat**qa** marhamatli **taklifingizni** qabul qila olmayman.

sentences.text: Why do some managers have such a negative **attitude towards** remote work?
sentences.translation: Nega ba'zi rahbarlarning masofaviy ish**ga munosabati** bunchalik salbiy?

sentences.text: The flood did a lot of **damage to** farms in the Fergana Valley.
sentences.translation: Toshqin Farg'ona vodiysidagi fermer xo'jaliklari**ga** katta **zarar keltirdi**.

sentences.text: After the earthquake, engineers checked every building for **damage to** the walls and foundations.
sentences.translation: Zilziladan keyin muhandislar har bir binoni devor va poydevor**ga zarar yetgan-yetmaganini** tekshirishdi.

examples.title: Relationships: **with** one, **between** two
examples.description: a relationship / connection / contact / problem with — kim yoki nima bilandir; ikki tomon birga tilga olinsa — between: the difference between A and B.

sentences.text: James has a very good **relationship with** his teenage son.
sentences.translation: Jeymsning o'smir o'g'li **bilan munosabati** juda yaxshi.

sentences.text: What's the **difference between** a flat and an apartment? — Nothing, really.
sentences.translation: Flat **bilan** apartment **o'rtasida** qanday **farq** bor? — Aslida hech qanday.

sentences.text: Since he moved to Edinburgh, Aziz has lost **contact with** most of his school friends.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga ko'chganidan beri Aziz maktabdoshlarining ko'pchiligi **bilan aloqani** yo'qotdi.

sentences.text: The **relationship between** the two neighbours got worse after the argument about the fence.
sentences.translation: Devor haqidagi janjaldan keyin ikki qo'shni **o'rtasidagi munosabat** yomonlashdi.

sentences.text: Scientists have found a clear **connection between** lack of sleep and weight gain.
sentences.translation: Olimlar uyqu yetishmasligi **bilan** vazn ortishi **o'rtasida** aniq **bog'liqlik** topishdi.

sentences.text: Is there a **problem with** your visa, or is everything ready?
sentences.translation: Vizangiz **bilan** biror **muammo** bormi yoki hammasi tayyormi?

sentences.text: Our office has close **contact with** universities in Tashkent and Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Ofisimiz Toshkent va Samarqanddagi universitetlar **bilan** yaqin **aloqada**.

sentences.text: There's a big **difference between** knowing the rules and actually using them.
sentences.translation: Qoidalarni bilish **bilan** ularni amalda qo'llash **o'rtasida** katta **farq** bor.

sentences.text: Police think the attack has a **connection with** last month's robbery.
sentences.translation: Politsiya bu hujumni o'tgan oydagi o'g'irlik **bilan bog'liq** deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: Nilufar's **relationship with** her in-laws improved once she and Bekzod moved into their own flat.
sentences.translation: Nilufar va Bekzod alohida kvartiraga ko'chib o'tgach, Nilufarning qaynona-qaynotasi **bilan munosabati** yaxshilandi.

examples.title: Mixed: news, business and everyday life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: for, of, in, to, with, between — bitta gapda ikkita «ot + predlog».

sentences.text: The main **cause of** the traffic jams is the sharp **increase in** private cars.
sentences.translation: Tirbandliklar**ning** asosiy **sababi** — shaxsiy avtomobillar sonining keskin **oshishi**.

sentences.text: According to the report, the **demand for** English teachers in Uzbekistan is growing fast.
sentences.translation: Hisobotga ko'ra, O'zbekistonda ingliz tili o'qituvchilari**ga talab** tez o'syapti.

sentences.text: Sarah's **reaction to** the price surprised me — she thought it was cheap!
sentences.translation: Saraning narx**ga munosabati** meni hayron qoldirdi — u buni arzon deb o'yladi!

sentences.text: One **disadvantage of** the new system is a **lack of** training for older staff.
sentences.translation: Yangi tizim**ning** bir **kamchiligi** — keksa xodimlar uchun o'qitish**ning yetishmasligi**.

sentences.text: We need a quick **solution to** the problem, so there's no **need for** a long meeting.
sentences.translation: Bu muammo**ga** tezkor **yechim** kerak, shuning uchun uzoq yig'ilish**ga hojat** yo'q.

sentences.text: Has the **relationship between** the two companies changed since the merger was cancelled?
sentences.translation: Qo'shilish bekor qilingandan beri ikki kompaniya **o'rtasidagi munosabat** o'zgardimi?

sentences.text: The insurance won't pay for **damage to** your phone if you dropped it yourself.
sentences.translation: Telefoningizni o'zingiz tushirib yuborgan bo'lsangiz, sug'urta unga **yetgan zararni** to'lamaydi.
